data.summary_en: MESH-Harness splits agent harness into role-interface functional modules, scores candidates via shared-module representations and full-covariance LinUCB, selects configs by mixed-start coordinate ascent; at matched candidate-evaluation budgets it beats Meta-Harness by 5.70, 7.01, 2.00, 5.00 points on text tasks, retrieval-augmented math reasoning, code generation, interactive-science tasks.
